components.name: Forest Button
components.description: The primary action on light sheets.
components.html: Choose your tree
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem; min-height: 3.1rem; padding: .7rem 1.4rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Onest, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.02rem; line-height: 1.1; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .2s, box-shadow .3s; } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--leaf, #3b8a4c); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-forest { background: var(--forest, #0f2b1d); color: var(--on-forest, #eef3ea); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(15,43,29,.6); } .ds-btn-forest:hover { background: var(--forest-2, #183d2a); }

components.name: Line Button
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; min-height: 3.1rem; padding: .7rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #131a15); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(19,26,21,.3); font-family: Onest, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.02rem; text-decoration: none; transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .3s; } .ds-btn-line:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ink, #131a15); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--leaf, #3b8a4c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Lime Button on Forest
components.description: The only lime button, used where it sits on a forest surface.
components.html: Clearing a block? Call Bruce
components.css: .ds-forest-ground { padding: 1.6rem; border-radius: 28px; background: var(--forest, #0f2b1d); } .ds-btn-lime { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 3.1rem; padding: .7rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--lime, #cdeb73); color: var(--forest, #0f2b1d); font-family: Onest, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.02rem; text-decoration: none; transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-lime:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-lime:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime, #cdeb73); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Order Pill
components.description: Header order pill with the lime live count.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .45rem; min-height: 2.8rem; padding: .45rem 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Onest, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: .98rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(19,26,21,.06), 0 18px 40px -22px rgba(19,40,25,.35); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--leaf, #3b8a4c); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-pill-order { background: var(--forest, #0f2b1d); color: var(--on-forest, #eef3ea); } .ds-pill-order:hover { background: var(--forest-2, #183d2a); } .ds-count { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; padding: 0 .35rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--lime, #cdeb73); color: var(--forest, #0f2b1d); font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Filter Chips
components.description: Shelf filters; selected turns forest and its count turns lime.
components.css: .ds-filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .4rem; } .ds-filter { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: .35rem; padding: .55rem 1.05rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--paper, #fff); color: var(--ink, #131a15); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule, #dfe2d8); font-family: Onest, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-filter small { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--ink-2, #4e564f); } .ds-filter:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink-2, #4e564f); } .ds-filter[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--forest, #0f2b1d); color: var(--on-forest, #eef3ea); box-shadow: none; } .ds-filter[aria-pressed='true'] small { color: var(--lime, #cdeb73); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--leaf, #3b8a4c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Floating Bar
components.description: Glass pill bar with pill links; the current link sits on lime wash.
components.html: replantsSizesRescueShopCare
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.2rem; padding: .4rem .45rem .4rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(250,251,246,.82); backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.2); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(19,26,21,.06), 0 18px 40px -22px rgba(19,40,25,.35); font-family: Onest, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mark { font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2rem; letter-spacing: -.03em; color: var(--ink, #131a15); } .ds-links { display: flex; gap: .2rem; margin: 0 auto; } .ds-links a { padding: .5rem .85rem; border-radius: 999px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: .96rem; color: var(--ink-2, #4e564f); transition: background-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-links a:hover { color: var(--ink, #131a15); } .ds-links a[aria-current] { background: var(--lime-2, #e6f5b8); color: var(--forest, #0f2b1d); } .ds-links a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--leaf, #3b8a4c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Paper field with rule stroke; leaf border and ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .35rem; font-family: Onest, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-weight: 500; font-size: .95rem; color: var(--ink, #131a15); } .ds-field input { min-height: 3rem; padding: .6rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #dfe2d8); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--paper, #fff); font: inherit; font-size: 1.125rem; color: var(--ink, #131a15); caret-color: var(--leaf, #3b8a4c); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #6e756d; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--leaf, #3b8a4c); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59,138,76,.18); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Paper sheet card with soft lift; rises on hover.
components.html:
12-month warranty

If a tree we planted fails in its first year, we replace it.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 22rem; padding: 1.6rem; border-radius: 28px; background: var(--paper, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(19,26,21,.06), 0 18px 40px -22px rgba(19,40,25,.35); font-family: Onest, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 .6rem; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.01em; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--ink, #131a15); } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--ink-2, #4e564f); }

components.name: Highlight Headline
components.description: Light Onest headline with one word on the lime pill, wiping in.
components.css: .ds-h2 { margin: 0; font-family: Onest, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 1.3rem + 2.8vw, 4rem); font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -.03em; color: var(--ink, #131a15); } .ds-hl { color: inherit; padding: 0 .18em; margin: 0 -.06em; border-radius: .5em; background: none; background-image: linear-gradient(var(--lime, #cdeb73), var(--lime, #cdeb73)); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: 100% 100%; -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-break: clone; animation: ds-wipe .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) .25s backwards; } @keyframes ds-wipe { from { background-size: 0% 100%; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hl { animation: none; } }

components.name: Photo Slices
components.description: One photo cut across four staggered rounded columns on forest.
components.css: .ds-slices { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 12px; height: 16rem; padding: 1.6rem; border-radius: 28px; background: var(--forest, #0f2b1d); align-items: start; } .ds-slices span { display: block; height: var(--h); margin-top: var(--t); border-radius: 22px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #8ab36a, #3b8a4c 45%, #6e4630); background-size: calc(400% + 36px) 112%; background-position: var(--x) 40%; animation: ds-settle 1.1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) backwards; } .ds-slices span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .1s; } .ds-slices span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .2s; } .ds-slices span:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: .3s; } @keyframes ds-settle { from { transform: translateY(12%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-slices span { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
One rescued grass tree is shown the way a botanist pins a specimen: alone, centred, lit, on a calm light sheet with a few small handwritten-feeling notes around it. Everything else steps back. The page is a stack of rounded sheets laid on a bone table, each one quiet and light, so that the tree in the hero and the one dark rescue chapter carry the story.

The voice is calm, light and premium rather than busy or folksy. One typeface does all the work, with very light large headlines and plain readable body text sized for an older audience. Colour is held almost entirely in the greens and bones; lime appears only as a pill behind a word or as the mark of something chosen. Photos are not shown as rectangles: they are cut across rounded columns or staggered pills that slide into place.

Motion is soft and reactive, never bouncy: content rises a short distance from an already visible state, highlights wipe in behind words, photo slices settle into their positions, and the 3D tree turns under the hand. The previous pop-up bush picture book world (cobalt table, red earth, wattle yellow, Gluten display face) is retired and nothing from it carries over.
keyCharacteristics: Bone ground with every section as a rounded 28px sheet inside a 12px frame.
One typeface, Onest, light 300 for display and headlines.
Lime only as a highlight or active state; forest for primary actions and the one dark chapter.
Pills for nav, buttons, chips, filters, counts and photo slices.
Four-point sparkles as the only ornament.
A WebGL grass tree on a floating soil-and-grass island as the hero object, with a photo fallback.

rules.name: The Lime Is A Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Full lime is only ever a pill behind a word, a count, or the mark of a chosen thing. It never fills a section, a card or a band. The hero's soft lime glow (a radial at 45% fading to nothing) is the one atmospheric use and stays behind the tree.

rules.name: The One Dark Chapter Rule
rules.body: Forest is the colour of action and of the rescue story. As a full sheet it appears once in the content (the rescue chapter) and once as the footer; within other sheets it is limited to buttons, selected states and the single "Talk to us" card.

rules.name: The Lime Button Lives On Forest Rule
rules.body: A lime button is used only where it sits on a forest surface (the rescue chapter, the "Talk to us" card). On light sheets the primary button is forest.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Onest is the only typeface. Hierarchy comes from size and weight (300 for anything large, 500 for anything you press), never from a second family.

rules.name: The Light Large Rule
rules.body: Anything set above 2rem is weight 300 with negative tracking. Large text is never bold.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headlines stand on their own. There are no small uppercase labels above them.

rules.name: The Sheet Not Box Rule
rules.body: Sections never get shadows; they read as rounded sheets by colour change against the bone table. Only objects that sit on a sheet or float above the page lift.

dos: Do keep lime (#cdeb73) to highlight pills, counts and selected states; use lime-2 for soft active surfaces.
Do make forest (#0f2b1d) the primary button colour on light sheets.
Do set every section as a 28px rounded sheet on the bone-table ground inside the 12px frame.
Do set anything above 2rem in Onest 300 with negative tracking.
Do use pills (999px) for anything pressable or that labels state, including photo slices.
Do start reveals from visible (opacity 0.25, 24px offset) on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
Do provide the photo fallback wherever a WebGL object appears.
donts: Don't fill a section, card or band with full lime.
Don't add a second dark chapter; forest as a full sheet is the rescue chapter and the footer.
Don't introduce a second typeface or set large text bold.
Don't add ornaments other than the four-point sparkle.
Don't put small uppercase labels or kickers above headlines.
Don't show rescue photos as plain rectangles where a sliced treatment fits.
Don't use bouncy or overshooting easing; motion settles softly.
Don't bring back the pop-up book palette (cobalt, red earth, wattle, ochre) or its display face.
